tests: normal and transaction publications return null without allocating confirm sequence
individual handles settle out of order while events and split notifications stay ordered
cumulative ack completes each publication exactly once
cumulative nack completes each publication exactly once
zero-tag multiple confirmation covers all outstanding handles
wait cancellation and timeout release only their own listeners and preserve confirmation
waiter limit is bounded and cancelled waiters immediately release capacity
broker confirm timeout settles handles false and retains the connection failure reason
channel close completes pending handles without fabricating broker nack events
connection destroy preserves acknowledged results and fails only unresolved handles
future confirmation fails closed without settling unrelated handle as acknowledged
duplicate confirmation fails closed without settling unrelated handle as acknowledged
throwing and rejected confirmation observers cannot corrupt protocol or other observers
local failures and pre-aborted publication do not consume sequence numbers
streamed deferred publication returns its handle only after the source finishes
nack is a false deferred result while ordinary publication still rejects
stream source failure rejects the send and closes the connection
normal connection close drains deferred confirmations before shutdown
unsequenced event buffer and outstanding handles share bounded publication capacity
connection recovery preserves observers, closes old handles and resets tagged generations
single-channel recovery resets its confirms while healthy sibling sequence survives
scope: Independent peer verifies deferred send/result separation, ordered notifications, cumulative and invalid confirmations, local wait cancellation/limits, shutdown, streaming, publication capacity and per-generation recovery. Real broker and native reference comparisons are separate.
